client.description: Indicates if the mod is client-side
client.title: Client side

server.description: Indicates if the mod is server-side
server.title: Server side

curseforge_enabled.description: Whether the artifact(s) should be published to Curseforge
curseforge_enabled.title: Deploy to Curseforge

modrinth_enabled.description: Whether the artifact(s) should be published to Modrinth
modrinth_enabled.title: Deploy to Modrinth

discord_enabled.description: Whether the normal release artifact(s) should be published to Discord
discord_enabled.title: Announce on Discord

discord_announce_nightly_builds.title: Announce nightly builds to discord
discord_announce_nightly_builds.description: Whether nightly builds should be announced to the nightly webhook

default_release_type.title: Default release type
default_release_type.description: Default release stability type. Can be overriden for each artifact.

username.description: Username used to send the webhook, defaults to the username configured when the webhook URL was created.
username.title: Username

avatar_url.title: Avatar URL
avatar_url.description: Avatar image URL for the webhook, defaults to the avatar configured when the webhook URL was created.

content.title: Content message
content.description:
Set the content message. The following placeholders are available: 
`{version}`, 
`{changelog}`
 Defaults to 
`v{version} was released!
{changelog}`

nightly_content.title: Content message for Nightly build
nightly_content.description:
Set the content message, the commit message is **always appended** after this content. Use `{version}` as a placeholder for the nightly version. Defaults to 
`v{version} Nightly build available!`

nightly_link_title.title: Nightly GitHub link title
nightly_link_title.description: The text of the link to GitHub workflow run containing the nightly build. Defaults to: `Download from GitHub (Login required)`

artifacts.title: Artifacts / Branches
artifacts.description: Configuration for artifacts that should be released

propertyNames.title: Artifact Identifier
propertyNames.description: Unique identifier of the artifact for purposes of this workflow. The name must be complaint with gradle task naming rules. Must not use `<space>` `/` `\` `:` `<` `>` `"` `?` `*` `|`. You should also not use `.` as a leading or trailing character.

embed.title: Discord Embed
embed.description:
An embed object to be sent with the Discord webhook.
Available placeholders: 
{version} The mod version without 'v' prefix, 
{changelog} The changelog contents

color.title: Color
color.description: Color of the left line used in the discord embed. Full `RRGGBB` hex color prefixed with a `#`.

icon_url.title: Icon URL
icon_url.description: The URL of the footer icon

file_glob.title: File glob
file_glob.description:
The glob for the compiled artifact to be uploaded. Can use `{version}` which will be replaced with the current mod version. E.g. 
`build/libs/*-1.21.1-neoforge-{version}.jar`

branch.title: Git Branch
branch.description: The name of the branch from which the artifact is compiled

release_type.description: The stability type of the release. If not specified, the Default release type is used.

loaders.title: Mod loaders
loaders.description: Mod loaders that can load the artifact

game_versions.title: Game versions
game_versions.description: Supported game versions for the artifact (e.g. `1.21.1`)

java_version.title: Java version
java_version.description: The java version required to build the branch and run the mod (e.g. `17`)

version_properties.title: File version replacements
version_properties.description: List of files and respective properties where the version should be set. Only supports properties format (`property=value`). Use your gradle build script to distribute the value to other files. If none is supplied, defaults to `mod_version` in `gradle.properties`.

file.title: File path
file.description: The exact relative path to the file (e.g. `gradle.properties`)

property.title: Property name
property.description: The name of the property which should be set to the version (e.g. `mod_version`)

dependencies.description: Dependencies for the artifact (merged with **common dependencies**)

release_type.title: Release type
release_type.description: The stability type of the release.

mr_dependency.title: Modrinth dependency
mr_dependency.description: Dependency on Modrinth platform. Only one, either ID or slug can be provided, you need to pick which value should be required. If you provide both values, ID takes priority and slug is not used.
